note: a1-after (Frame 3, cut 2): the evidence board. Anchored to the same words as the scene's tweens; each offset is the scene's beat-snapped time (clk.b / clk.c on the 92 BPM grid) minus its word under the current narration, so on a narration re-lock these offsets should be re-derived from the scene (tl.data lists the times). Pins land on consecutive half beats. The rewind sound belongs to a1-world.
